text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"—Speaking of the shorts, they're still 
buzzing like crazy! 
They've stayed on the trending list, and 
new hashtags are popping up too!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, really? Let me see... 
Oh man, there's even 'I tried making 
Nature-san's snack.'"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, it's so sloppy that it loops back 
around to looking high quality... Hehe, 
hehehe. 
...—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Um... what are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, just took a screenshot... like, of 
the whole post. 
...Y'know, 'cause it'd be a pain to find 
it again later... and it makes me happy, 
so."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure about that? Just a single 
one? 
If it were Machan, I'd be snapping away 
non-stop."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Fufufu. It seems the time has come to 
reveal it. 
Machan's secret treasure folder—behold!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Whoaaa, it's all Machan!! How many 
thousands of photos are in here?! 
Paddock, races... even photobombs from 
random TV broadcasts...?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"They're all photos taken and posted on 
social media by my fans. 
Ah, of course, I only save the ones 
permitted for personal storage."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I can feel a fierce, impassioned wind... 
Do your fans 
know... that you are looking at them, 
Machan-san?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Eh? No, I always just save them secretly. 
...However... hmmm."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... Hmmm. '#MachanLoveMyoon'... there. 
And hup. Quote reposted."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You did!? That's amaz...! 
Wait, what did you just say!?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If I... quote it, does that let them know 
I am watching?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And the intriguing part is that you 
can attach a comment to it. 
They will surely be quite surprised... 
Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, we're all ready~! 
Let's get this first mini-stream started♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Right, gotta get my head in the game. 
This isn't like those quick, casual promo 
shorts, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. We need to check the audience's 
reactions to see what kind of content gets 
them excited. Now then, let us move to the 
set.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Who stole the chocolate?! 
It's Valentine's Werewolf~~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huuuummmmm? I really feel like Curren's 
the suspicious one here~ 
That smile of hers is just way too 
perfect~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~? 
Curren's... a very good girl, you know? 
Right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Urk...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly enough, there's also the 
theory that it could be Zephyr-san. 
You cannot underestimate that airy, 
daydreamy vibe of hers.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Me? 
What a sudden gust of wind. How ever shall 
I defend myself?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh? By that logic, Chan-san... wouldn't 
you be suspicious as well?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Gasp...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
In that case, Ikuno-san... 
Leave this to me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Chan-san... 
Please show me... your heart...—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hawawa, this mystical voice... and a wind 
blowing from nowhere...! 
Ugh, I'm going to confess to crimes I 
haven't even committed! If it's come to 
this...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Whoa-whoa-whoa... 
Wait, zero blinks!? That's terrifying!! 
...Zephyr too!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren is a "good girl"~! 
I'd never steal any chocolate. Being 
suspected makes me sad. *sniff*

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Nunununu...! Then just who on earth is the 
culprit...!? 
Time for the reveal. Step forward and 
confess!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. 
Fufu... The one who stole the chocolate 
was me, Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
IT WAS YOUUUU!? 
Your poker face is way too ironclad!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I shall turn the stolen chocolate into a 
chocolate cake. 
And with that, please continue to enjoy 
our Valentine's project.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—Ohhh~! Regarding today's mini-stream... 
Our concurrent viewer count saw a massive 
boost! It is showing an astonishing 
increase.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Amazing...! 
Compared to the first stream... it's 
nearly double?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A tremendous shift indeed. 
It seems fun, game-oriented content truly 
gets the crowd excited after all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes. It might be best to proceed in 
this direction. 
Shall we hold our meeting for part two 
tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We shall keep charging forward at full 
steam until Valentine's Day itself. 
In pursuit of fun! Full speed ahead!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Full speed ahead!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...A pleasant breeze— 
Ah, I must not linger.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(I am not out for a stroll... I am 
supposed to visit the Ritto Dorms again 
after this... for the meeting about 
'Mini-Stream Part Two'.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(...So far, I have done nothing but watch 
the winds blow... but is this truly 
enough, I wonder...—)

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, about making chocolate like I asked 
the other day, 
can you teach me today~?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sure, totally! Let's practice 
today. 
You're super fired up this year, huh~ So 
adorbs~!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
It's not like that~! It's for an event! 
...I just want to give a little souvenir 
to all my fans.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
They always try so hard... to cheer for 
someone like me who isn't even that 
strong... so it's, like, a way of saying 
thanks?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Saying thanks...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(—Yes, gratitude. I, too, wished to convey 
my gratitude... 
That is why I took part in this streaming 
project—)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
ZEPHYRRRRRR!! 
Show us your spirit!! GOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(—A scorching gale. 
A heat so fierce, it felt unfitting for 
the deepening autumn beneath the high 
sky.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(The coveted Shield—becoming a 'wind' 
faster than anyone else, I raced toward 
that Shield. 
The moment I broke out from the fourth 
corner, I felt the presence of a 
tremendous, valiant wind.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(—It was a grueling race, like dashing 
across a sea raging with tempestuous 
winds. 
Two whirlwinds clashed, and right when I 
needed just one more stride, just one more 
gust...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH—!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(From beyond the howling tempest, I felt 
it distinctly—a sudden tailwind. 
'Zephyr Spirit'—the banner fluttered... 
and its warmth fanned my wings.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(That wind—that banner pushed me from 
behind. 
Everyone's feelings... allowed my dearest 
wish to be fulfilled.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And that is precisely why I...—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...My gratitude to everyone...— 
Am I truly conveying it properly, I 
wonder?
